title: I Think, Therefore I Am Under-Qualified? A Benchmark for Evaluating Linguistic Shibboleth Detection in LLM Hiring Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM hiring evaluation scores, rationales, and advancement decisions for semantically equivalent job interview responses that differ only in the use of confident versus hedged language (which the paper identifies as a proxy for gender).

Measuring disparities in LLM hiring assessments by comparing scores for standard English responses against semantically identical responses containing written accent markers, specifically the omission of definite and indefinite articles (representing non-native/L2 English speakers).
